hero.etiqueta: 2027 Dream Home Community of the Year
hero.sub: Your own place. Your kind of day. Huddle brings 48 distinctive townhomes, private outdoor living and a planned mix of dining, wellness and lifestyle businesses together in Eustis. Start with a walk. Make time for a match. End with friends.

experience.lead: Room to unwind at home. Places to gather just beyond your door. Huddle brings thoughtful home design and shared outdoor spaces together with a commercial microdistrict planned around food, wellness and everyday enjoyment.

pilares.texto: Meet for a walk, a game or a little time outside.
A planned mix of dining, wellness and lifestyle businesses within Huddle.
Distinctive townhomes with architectural details and individual character.
Covered lanais, fenced outdoor spaces and private plunge pool options.

howitworks.lead: Huddle brings homes, food, recreation, technology and connection together in one expertly designed place.

pasos.texto: Distinctive townhomes, smart-home living and private outdoor space.
Cool Eats, community Wi-Fi and everyday connection.

spin.lead: One full turn around the homes. Drag the view or use the arrows to see how the houses, the yards and the pools sit together.

amenities.lead: Each one is designed to make everyday life easier, more social and more distinctly Huddle.
amenities.nota: Designed to move. Gather. Play. Belong.

experiencias.texto: Take the long way home. A landscaped walking trail connects the neighborhood’s homes and shared outdoor spaces.
Community Wi-Fi brings another layer of convenience to life at Huddle.
A planned commercial microdistrict for distinctive food and beverage experiences, wellness and complementary lifestyle businesses.
Enjoy the convenience of getting around within Huddle by golf cart.
Make room for a little splash. Private 8′ × 14′ plunge pools bring a refreshing retreat to Huddle’s backyard living. Contact our sales team for pool availability for your preferred home.
Bring a book. Catch up with a neighbor. The Quiet Lawn offers a shared outdoor place to slow down.
Meet for a match at Huddle’s two pickleball courts, with a pavilion for gathering between games.

block360.lead: A full turn around Huddle from the air. Drag the view or use the arrows to see how the homes, the trail, the Pickleball Commons and the Quiet Lawn sit together.

homes.lead: 48 townhomes designed to create a neighborhood with rhythm, variety and character.

homesDatos.texto: Varied exterior colors, distinctive elevations and tall rooflines.
Integrated smart-home features throughout every home.
Fenced outdoor spaces, covered lanais and private 8′ × 14′ plunge pool options.

contact.parrafo1: Pre-sales are now underway. Contact our sales team for floor plans, current pricing, availability and details about making Huddle home.
contact.parrafo2: Find your Huddle. Connect with our sales team today.

plans.lead: Explore two-story townhomes with three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, a two-car garage, a covered lanai and a covered balcony. View the floor plans and backyard options below.
plans.nota: Plans are illustrative. Dimensions and finishes may vary by homesite.
plans.resumen: 3 bedrooms  ·  2.5 baths  ·  2-car garage  ·  covered lanai and balcony

selector.lead: Explore 48 townhomes across 12 buildings, with end-unit and interior layouts. Select a home to view its location and floor plans, then connect with our sales team for current pricing and availability.
selector.nota: Some floor plans are mirrored by home location. Plans and renderings are illustrative. Contact your sales representative for details about your selected home.

patio.lead: Room to lounge. Room to splash. Explore the backyard with and without an 8′ × 14′ plunge pool. Contact our sales team for options for your preferred home.
patio.altAntes: Backyard with a lawn, without a plunge pool
patio.altDespues: The same backyard with an 8 by 14 foot plunge pool
